item.title: Iran hostage survivor says Trump 'absolutely' right to launch Operation Epic Fury, finally confront regime
item.summary: Kevin Hermening, the youngest of 52 hostages in the 1979 Iranian hostage crisis, said Trump and Operation Epic Fury are finally getting Iran policy right.

item.title: Polls: Most Americans oppose strikes on Iran, but big gap between Democrats, Republicans
item.summary: Multiple national polls show most Americans now oppose U.S.-Israel military strikes on Iran, with opposition ranging from 54% to 61% across surveys.

item.title: Teen mobs swarm downtown in chaotic takeover—fights erupt, cars targeted before curfew crackdown hits
item.summary: Eight juveniles were arrested and 24 curfew violations issued after a large teen gathering turned chaotic in downtown Chicago's Loop Wednesday night.

item.title: Dementia risk signals could lie in simple blood pressure readings, say researchers
item.summary: New research suggests that routine blood pressure checks may predict dementia risk years before symptoms, with one metric linked to a 76% higher risk in adults under 65.

item.title: Ted Danson admits he can be a ‘d---,’ says wife Mary Steenburgen compares him to a ‘junkyard dog’
item.summary: Mary Steenburgen told Ted Danson he is "mean as a junkyard dog," a candid remark that helped the actor rethink his long-held nice guy self-image.

item.title: Driver plows through airport gate onto airfield, sneaks onto planes before police takedown, bodycam shows
item.summary: Bryan Parker, 58, allegedly drove drunk onto the Daytona Beach airport airfield and tried boarding planes. He faces aircraft piracy and DUI charges.

item.title: Stefanik grills University of Michigan leader on lack of audit after string of Chinese national arrests
item.summary: University of Michigan's interim president was questioned about an audit after a string of arrests of Chinese students related to national security.

item.title: ICE agent saves life of 'unresponsive' 1-year-old boy in JFK airport as panic ensues in TSA security line
item.summary: A quick-thinking ICE agent saved the life of a 1-year-old boy who stopped breathing at JFK Airport by performing the Heimlich maneuver, DHS said.

item.title: Trump explains voting by mail: 'I'm president' with 'a lot' going on
item.summary: President Donald Trump said he voted by mail in Florida's special election because he is president with "a lot of different things" going on.

item.title: NHL star's fiancée makes emotional return after undergoing harrowing heart transplant ordeal
item.summary: Rasmus Dahlin's fiancée, Carolina Matovac,returned to a Sabres game months after suffering major heart failure and receiving a transplant in France.
